# Tax Deed Due Diligence Research Pack

> A $149 per property, research only PDF of cited public record information for one US property, built for tax deed investors and delivered by email, usually within about 4 business hours after payment and the property address or APN are received. It is not an appraisal, title search, legal advice, or bid recommendation, and any fact without an establishing source is marked NOT VERIFIED. Seller and legal details are on the Terms page (https://taxdeedpack.com/terms.html).

## Product

- [Home and overview](https://taxdeedpack.com/): What the Research Pack includes, what it does not include, how ordering works, and investor FAQs.
- [Order a Research Pack](https://taxdeedpack.com/order.html): Submit an address or APN, county and state, accept the required agreement, and pay $149 through Stripe.

## Guides

- [Florida tax deed due diligence checklist](https://taxdeedpack.com/guides/florida-tax-deed-due-diligence-checklist.html): 12 step checklist for researching a Florida tax deed property before the auction, with Florida Statutes ch. 197 citations on liens, redemption, deposits and payment.
